newsitem.title: USA: Pueblo Xtra Int'l to sell $85 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pueblo Xtra Int'l to sell $85 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: Pueblo Xtra International Inc plans to raise $85 million through the sale of junk bonds in the U.S. in the next several weeks, according to market sources.
The privately-held company operates 50 supermarkets and 29 Blockbuster video rental stores in Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
The deal, which will be conducted as a 144a private placement, is an add-on to a $180 million junk bond issue which was brought to market in 1993, market sources said.
Proceeds from the offering will be used to repay bank debt, they added.
NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc and Scotia Capital Markets will serve as joint co-lead managers of the deal. Morgan Stanley & Co Inc was the underwriter for the original offering in 1993.
The offering will consist of 9-1/2 percent senior notes due 2003.
The notes will be redeemable by the company after February 1, 1998 for 104.75, after February 1, 1999 at 102.375 and after February 1, 2000 at 100.
